purpose: Ten three-phase concept strips, not runtime assets

records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: hand-painted game VFX concept strip for Asterveil Fateweave, NOT a screenshot, NOT a character illustration. Create a wide horizontal strip, requested 1536x512, with THREE equally spaced isolated effect drawings, one per equal-width column: anticipation, single impact peak, dissolve. Each whole effect stays inside its own column, centred, with clear empty gutters and generous transparent margins. Genuine transparent RGBA background. No text, labels, numbers, panel frames, ground, characters, weapons, interface, scenery or watermark. Refined painterly anime fantasy: deliberately shaped tapered brushwork, delicate tiny hard ivory core, rich but restrained coloured underside, very low soft glow, much transparent negative space. Medium weight: readable at 390px phone width when each effect is 65–110px, never a bulky opaque white mass, never a faint generic line. The three phases are different drawings of ONE continuous gesture, not repeated strikes. Keep the impact centre open enough that a character silhouette remains visible. Anticipation roughly 35% impact footprint; decay about 40% ink of peak. Only the named gesture; avoid fire, lightning, large particle sprays, circles, radial explosions, multistrikes or full-screen bloom. 
Specific skill identity: ATTACK: a compact single diagonal saber-comma. One thin ivory edge with dusty rose underside, a short clean curved stroke ending in a needle tip. Modest everyday cut, no full crescent. Anticipation is a tiny blade-edge hairline; impact is the compact comma; decay is one fading curved filament and two pinpricks.
